removedUpstreamPaths..github/workflows/bonk.yml: Cloudflare's internal review bot, which needs a GitHub App installation this fork lacks.
removedUpstreamPaths..github/workflows/bonk-pr.yml: The PR half of the same bot; its break-glass path also assumes that App.
removedUpstreamPaths..github/workflows/contribution-policy.ym: Enforces Cloudflare's policy on Cloudflare's repository -- it closes outside PRs and points contributors at cloudflare/cloudflare-os. Whether this fork takes contributions is our call.
removedUpstreamPaths.scripts/contribution-policy.ts: Only consumer was contribution-policy.yml, via actions/github-script.
removedUpstreamPaths.scripts/contribution-policy.test.ts: Tests the above, and reads the workflow file, so it cannot outlive either.
